title: AI-Generated Images for representing Individuals: Navigating the Thin Line Between Care and Bias
findings: The paper found that generating diverse representations, such as a woman in a hijab, required extensive and specific prompt refinement. This indicates that the AI image model does not represent religious diversity by default and can reinforce visual stereotypes or underrepresentation without careful intervention.

measurement_description: The paper does not present a formal benchmark but rather an analysis of a design study. It qualitatively assesses the ability of an AI image generator to represent demographic diversity, including one example related to religious attire (a hijab), and the biases inherent in the model's outputs.
